guard: every external package loaded by the published manager Node entrypoint is installed as a production dependency
why: The 0.33.9 published manager imported three NATS packages from dist while declaring them only as devDependencies.
The mutations cover both failure modes named by the incident: moving the production dependency block back
to devDependencies and removing each direct NATS dependency. The graph-derived assertion must name the package.

mutations.name: M1 manager production dependencies move back to devDependencies
mutations.expectRed: published manager runtime dependency is installed: @nats-io/transport-node

mutations.name: M2 transport-node is removed
mutations.expectRed: published manager runtime dependency is installed: @nats-io/transport-node

mutations.name: M3 kv is removed
mutations.expectRed: published manager runtime dependency is installed: @nats-io/kv

mutations.name: M4 jetstream is removed
mutations.expectRed: published manager runtime dependency is installed: @nats-io/jetstream
